start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj hum perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein kaunsa shape pasand hai?

turns.line: sab bekaar lagta hai, koi mujhse baat nahi karta
turns.reply: Kabir, yeh sunkar lagta hai ki aap bahut akela mehsoos kar rahe hain. Kya aap abhi okay hain?
Theek hai, Kabir. Agar koi baat phir pareshaan kare, trusted grown-up ko batayiye. Ab fencing wale vegetable patch ka boundary naapne mein kya jodenge?
